messages:
Lia Chen: quick heads-up — ran per-layer activation scan on galactica-13b with AWQ-int8 profile against summarization devset. seeing a concentrated error on layers 17-19, plus recurring channel spikes in layer 18.
Omar Patel: can you paste the top-k offending channels and sample activations?
Lia Chen: sure — sample rows:
```
layer 18 channel 1023 mean=12.8 std=4.9 max=289.3
layer 18 channel 2047 mean=11.3 std=5.1 max=301.6
layer 17 channel 64   mean=0.9  std=0.4 max=45.2
```
Jess (eng-ml): yikes 300 max looks like a numeric overflow/rare outlier. Did GPTQ quantize with per-channel scales?
Lia Chen: AWQ run used per-group 64, mixed-quant. GPTQ run (baseline) didn't show same perf regression on the eval — but cost was 2x.
Kai: hypothesis: a few channels have long-tail activations that break int8 scale fit. options: clamp, channel-rescale, skip-layer, or per-channel remap.
Matt: can you try surgical clamp first? clip top 0.01% to 6*sigma and re-eval.
Lia Chen: did that — quick check:
```
clip 6*sigma => delta accuracy +0.9% (vs AWQ baseline)
channel-rescale (manifold) => +1.6%
skip layer 18 entirely => +2.8% but latency +12ms
```
Omar Patel: skip layer looks best accuracy-wise but cost/latency hit might be unacceptable in prod.
Jess (eng-ml): does skip-layer create mismatch with non-quantized models for caching or KV shape? we need to ensure fallback model compatibility.
Lia Chen: good call — skipping layer produced different KV cache length by one step in our runner; fixed by aligning shapes via noop-residual hook, but added engineering debt.
Kai: What about per-channel symmetric clipping in AWQ quantizer? or adaptive quant bin width per-channel?
Lia Chen: next plan: run 3-way bakeoff across FP8, AWQ-int8 w/ clamp, and GPTQ per-channel with channel-rescale. We'll include latency, mem, cost and accuracy deltas. Will post results tomorrow.
Matt: please also include small prompt set P1 (summaries), P2 (longform Q&A), and SLO gate checks for 95th latency.
quant-bot: scheduled bakeoff job: infra-job/1802501111-clip-sweep v2 queued on dedicated-gpu-pool
Omar Patel: nice. if bakeoff favors channel-rescale we should prototype an automated detector to flip rescale at deploy-time.
Jess (eng-ml): agreed. also add a regression test that replays the failing prompts after any quantizer change :thumbsup:
Lia Chen: noted — will attach raw logs and config in next message.
